"""Trust guard for filesystem path handling in request handlers."""


def classify_line(line):
    """Classify a source line as untrusted-path handling or static."""
    text = line.strip().lower()
    untrusted = "request" in text or "req." in text
    touches_path = "path" in text
    if untrusted and touches_path:
        return "untrusted-path"
    return "static"


def resolve(line, base="/var/lib/app"):
    """Resolve the path operand of an untrusted-path line under base."""
    if classify_line(line) != "untrusted-path":
        return None
    operand = line.split("=", 1)[-1].strip().strip("'\"")
    return base + "/" + operand
